statement: US military forces conduct at least one kinetic strike on a target inside the territory of Iran between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: True if US Central Command or the White House publicly confirms, or Reuters and AP both report, a US kinetic strike on a target inside Iran occurring between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-15. Interceptions of Iranian projectiles do not count.
failure_condition: No US kinetic strike on a target inside the territory of Iran occurs between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-15.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-07, the Ukrainian Air Force reports at least one overnight Russian attack in which 500 or more drones and missiles combined were launched against Ukraine.
resolution: True if an official Ukrainian Air Force daily report, as carried by Reuters, AP or Ukrinform, states that Russia launched 500 or more drones and missiles combined in a single overnight attack dated between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-07.
failure_condition: Every overnight Russian attack on Ukraine between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-07 involves fewer than 500 drones and missiles combined.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle at or above 125.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 111.70 USD on the packet date 2026-10-24.
resolution: True if the ICE Brent front-month futures official daily settlement price is 125.00 USD per barrel or higher on any trading day between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20, per ICE settlement data. Reference: 111.70 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20 is below 125.00 USD per barrel.
